dict.string: VoxOS needs access to your microphone to record audio for transcription.
VoxOS needs to interact with your browser to detect the current website for applying website-specific configurations.
VoxOS shows a short notice in the notch when a Bluetooth device such as your AirPods connects, with its battery.
VoxOS shows your next events on the notch's Today page.
VoxOS listens to what your Mac is playing only to move the music bars in the notch. Nothing is recorded or stored.
VoxOS needs screen recording access to understand context from your screen for improved transcription accuracy.
VoxOS uses your location when you ask it to, e.g. "what's my current location?"
